blocks.text: "Provider" means the entity delivering services under this Agreement. "Client" means the entity receiving services. "Services" means all cloud computing services described herein.
The Provider shall maintain and operate cloud infrastructure with a minimum of three availability zones. All data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3.
Round-the-clock monitoring shall be provided with a maximum response time of 15 minutes for critical incidents and 4 hours for non-critical issues.
Base pricing is set at $50,000 per month with annual escalation of 3%. Overage charges apply beyond the agreed compute thresholds.
